description: Questions asking 'how many customers' who did X should use COUNT(DISTINCT customers.id), not COUNT(orders.id), to avoid double-counting customers with multiple qualifying orders.

check.message: count customers with COUNT(DISTINCT customers.id) (or DISTINCT orders.customer_id) when orders are joined, so a customer with several orders is counted once.

description: Product names in orders.product should be matched case-insensitively, since user phrasing (e.g. 'notebooks') may be plural while stored values (e.g. 'Notebook') are singular and capitalized.
